# ComparisonOperandsOrder

<Badge type="info" text="info" /> <Badge type="info" text="off by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" /> 

Group: [Code style](/rules/#code-style) · PhpStorm name: `ComparisonOperandsOrderInspection`

Enforces one consistent operand order for equality comparisons against a
literal/constant: with the project-wide comparison style set to *yoda*, the
literal must come first (`10 === $n`); with the *regular* style (default), the
variable part must come first (`$n === 10`).

## Example

Style yoda:

::: code-group

```php{3,4,5,6,7} [Before]
<?php

$isZero  = $counter === 0;
$isNeg   = $delta != -3;
$isOn    = $flag == true;
$isUnix  = $sep !== "/";
$fileOk  = $path <> __FILE__;

// no report
$same    = 'a' === $label;
$both    = PHP_INT_MAX == 99;
$classes = $mode === Mode::FAST;
$less    = $counter < 5;
```

```php [After fix]
<?php

$isZero  = 0 === $counter;
$isNeg   = -3 != $delta;
$isOn    = true == $flag;
$isUnix  = "/" !== $sep;
$fileOk  = __FILE__ <> $path;

// no report
$same    = 'a' === $label;
$both    = PHP_INT_MAX == 99;
$classes = $mode === Mode::FAST;
$less    = $counter < 5;
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 3: Put the constant operand on the left side of the comparison.</li>
<li>line 4: Put the constant operand on the left side of the comparison.</li>
<li>line 5: Put the constant operand on the left side of the comparison.</li>
<li>line 6: Put the constant operand on the left side of the comparison.</li>
<li>line 7: Put the constant operand on the left side of the comparison.</li>
</ul>

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| (none) | | | Driven by the global comparison style setting (`comparisonStyle`: `regular` default, or `yoda`). |

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "ComparisonOperandsOrder": {
      "enabled": true
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore ComparisonOperandsOrder

/**
 * @noinspection ComparisonOperandsOrderInspection
 */
```
